verdict.rationale: Antigravity's agent can work across the editor, terminal and browser. It can delegate test runs and extensive codebase searches to subagents, and it produces browser recordings and code diffs as artifacts. Together these plausibly support reproducing issues, locating causes and checking fixes. However, no documented debugging or root-cause workflow ties these pieces together, so this rests on general agent capabilities. Missing for 10: an explicit debugging or issue-reproduction workflow, a debugger or breakpoint integration, documented root-cause analysis features, and independent hands-on corroboration of bug-fixing and verification loops.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reproduce issues, narrow down root causes, and verify fixes
